sources.title: GitHub - gsoh/VED: VED (Vehicle Energy Dataset): A Large-scale Dataset ...
sources.snippet: A novel large-scale database for fuel and energy use of diverse vehicles in real-world. VED captures GPS trajectories of vehicles along with their timeseries data of fuel, energy, speed, and auxiliary power usage, and the data was collected through onboard OBD-II loggers from Nov, 2017 to Nov, 2018 ...
